name: add-contrast-curve
summary: Add mid-tone contrast with a gentle S-curve on an adjustment layer.
when: The image looks flat or hazy: histogram bunched in the middle, no real blacks or whites.
photoshop: Layer > New Adjustment Layer > Curves, drag the shadow quarter down and the highlight quarter up
notes: Very hazy images first need black and white points set (Levels or the Curves endpoints) to where the histogram actually starts and ends. Strong curves also raise saturation; set the layer to Luminosity blend if colors get loud.
